Hooker' as a pro synonym of Stenosolenium saxatile (Pall.) Turcz. (1840). Although the epithet 'saxatile'and the the parenthetical authorship '(Turczaninow)' are correctable to 'saxatilis' and '(Pallas)', there is no evidence that Bentham & Hooker published this new combination.  In their 'Genera Plantarum' book (2: 862. 1876), they treated the genus Arnebia as an accepted genus name and cited Stenosolenium as a synonym, but they did not make any new combination.  Since Bentham and Hooker included Stenosolenium as a synonym under Arnebia, some botanists probably erroneously assumed that the new combination A. saxatilis was automatically made in Bentham and Hooker's work.]
